policyReview.summary: Rechecked official Google Publisher Policies, AdSense policies, Search Essentials and scaled-content spam guidance on 2026-11-21. No material policy change identified. Google prohibits copied/low-value content and ads on screens without publisher content; scaled-content abuse applies regardless of whether content is produced by AI, automation or people. No fixed minimum word count or article count is stated in the reviewed guidance.
